scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/execution/tsconfig.json && pnpm -C packages/verification typecheck && pnpm -C packages/evaluation typecheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/openrouter-connection.test.mjs scripts/backend-relay.test.mjs && vp test run && vp -C apps/web test run && node --experimental-transform-types --test packages/execution/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm -C packages/verification test && pnpm -C packages/evaluation test
scripts.build:worker: vp -C apps/web build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=dist/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" --outdir dist/worker --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
